tools.name: bria_generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Bria's licensed visual model. Starts an async job and returns request_id and status_url: poll bria_get_status until status is COMPLETED, then read result.image_url. Each call uses credits on the account's plan (API access needs a paid plan). Bria API: POST /

tools.name: bria_get_status
tools.description: Get the progress and result of an async Bria job by request_id (from bria_generate_image or bria_remove_background). When status is COMPLETED, result holds the output, such as result.image_url. Bria API: GET /v2/status/{request_id}.

tools.name: bria_remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background from an image and return a transparent cut-out as an async job (poll bria_get_status for result.image_url). The image is a public URL or a base64 string (JPEG, PNG or WEBP). Each call uses credits on the account's plan. Bria API: POST /v2/image/edit/remove_background.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bria_generate_image · Public sink: bria_generate_image, bria_remove_background · Destructive: bria_remove_background.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bria_generate_image · Public sink: bria_generate_image, bria_remove_background · Destructive: bria_remove_background

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
